newsitem.title: CROATIA: Eurokuna to be listed on Croatian bourse next week.
newsitem.headline: Eurokuna to be listed on Croatian bourse next week.

text.p: Croatia's maiden issue of 300 million kuna Eurobonds will probably be listed on the central bourse next week, the Zagreb Stock Exchange said on Thursday.
"Before then we expect the Finance Ministry to provide some additional data regarding clearing and settlement," Vladimir Puskaric of the listing committe told Reuters by telephone.
He said a solution also had to be found to regulate trading in Zagreb as the bourse has an order-driven system, while four banks agreed to be market makers for the bonds in Croatia.
The ministry requested listing for two-year Eurokuna on both Zagreb's and Luxembourg stock exchanges last month, expecting the procedure to be completed by January 8.
The issue, carrying an interest of 12.5 percent a year, was led by Merrill Lynch and Zagrebacka Banka. It matures on December 18, 1998.
The placement of the roughly 150 million kuna domestic tranche closed this week, with a larger portion said to have been bought by institutions. -- Kolumbina Bencevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
